shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab/stela
anthropomorphic or animal figures in profile
horizontal band of repeated small motifs
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low-relief figural imagery with a horizontal band of repeated small motifs across the upper area and profile creatures below, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows a single elaborately costumed frontal human figure with headdress, ornaments and blocks of sign-like glyph cartouches, while B shows a T-shaped pillar with a row of animal heads, a fringe/net band, and separate profile quadrupeds and long-necked birds with no central human figure — different subject matter and different relief conventions.
